tools.name: search_races
tools.description: Find upcoming HYROX races by city/name text, country, and date range. Returns dates, venue, divisions, ticket status and page links.

tools.name: get_race
tools.description: Full details for one race by slug (from search_races): facts, the race-weekend guide (hotels, gyms, food, recovery, things to do with Google Maps links, FAQ) when available, and athletes racing it who want sponsors.

tools.name: search_athletes
tools.description: List HYROX athletes looking for sponsors, optionally filtered by race slug, country they live in (name or ISO code) or division (open, pro, doubles, pro_doubles, relay, adaptive).

tools.name: get_athlete
tools.description: One athlete's public profile: location, division, best time, race results, upcoming races and their sponsor page link.

tools.name: how_sponsorship_works
tools.description: How RoxSkin works for athletes and brands, the sponsor spots (up to 15 per avatar) with default prices, refund rules and FAQ.

tools.name: hyrox_format
tools.description: The HYROX race format (8 x 1 km runs + 8 stations) and station loads by division for the current season (confirm against the current rulebook before racing).

tools.name: get_training_guide
tools.description: Read one of the guides as markdown. Available slugs: what-is-hyrox, hyrox-stations-weights, hyrox-divisions-explained, hyrox-training-plan-beginner, hyrox-training-plan-intermediate, hyrox-training-plan-advanced, hyrox-pacing-and-roxzone, hyrox-race-day-packing-list, hyrox-rules-what-is-not-allowed,

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_training_guide" is 1656 chars, far longer than this server's median (157). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Read one of the guides as markdown. Available slugs: what-is-hyrox, hyrox-stations-weights, hyrox-divisions-explained, hyrox-training-plan-beginner, hyrox-train…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "how_sponsorship_works" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How RoxSkin works for athletes and brands, the 15 sponsor spots with default prices, refund rules and FAQ." → after: "How RoxSkin works for athletes and brands, the sponsor spots (up to 15 per avatar) with default prices, refund rules and FAQ."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
